regime_context: Broad eligible rotation (78%) with Memory/HBM leading but fading (durability 0.44, zero breadth, mixed trend). AI Infrastructure challenges; Cybersecurity and Gold Miners exhibit strong durability and trend. The absolute-trend gate is validated for drawdown control. Past calls have only 40% hit rate – lean low conviction.
emerging_watch: AI Infrastructure (challenger, durability 0.51, breadth 0.33) may handoff lead if it closes the score gap with Memory to <0.2 and breadth expands for 10 consecutive days; retire watch if Memory's breadth recovers above 0.2 for 5 days.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Headline theme is showing fading leadership (val_state=fading), mixed trend (hurst=mixed), zero breadth, and low durability (0.44). Without breadth or trend health, its top-rank momentum may be exhausted. The underweight is a defensive reduction, not a fade call.
theses.dissent: Memory could be consolidating before a fresh leg up; HBM demand fundamentals remain strong, and low crowd may lead to re-acceleration.

falsifier.text: SMH outperforms SPY by more than 3% before 2026-08-28

theses.subject: Cybersecurity
theses.thesis: Cybersecurity exhibits the highest durability (0.90), a confirmed trend (hurst=trend), perfect breadth (1.0), and eligibility. Crowding (z=2.02) warrants sizing caution but does not negate the trend. The thesis is to maintain exposure with reduced size per crowding flag.
theses.dissent: Extreme crowding may precede mean-reversion; a crowded durable trend is still vulnerable to sharp de-grossing events.

falsifier.text: CIBR underperforms SPY by more than 5% before 2026-09-18

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners combine strong durability (0.81), trend confirmation (hurst=trend), full breadth (1.0), and no crowding (z=0.06). This offers a cleaner trend-following candidate with low reflexive risk.
theses.dissent: Gold miners are sensitive to gold price, which can be whipsawed by real rates and unscheduled macro events; a shift in Fed policy could reverse the trend.

falsifier.text: GDX underperforms SPY by more than 5% before 2026-09-18
